Order No. 13 of 2024
My Ref. No.: 4-3/4/2017/LO/513. Divisional Secretary's Ref. No.: 3/7/16/2.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Order under Section 38(a) of Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Column 1 of the Schedule to take possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Column 2 of that Schedule.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,No.1200/06, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.24th January, 2025.
SCHEDULE
1. Acquiring Oﬃ cer.- Divisional Secretary, Walapane, Nildandahinna.

2. Description of the Land.- The allotment of land depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. Nu3362 dated 08.06.2020 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Wathumulla in 515B Walapane Grama Niladhari Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division Walapane in Nuwaraeliya District of Central Province and bounded as follows:

1. Lot No. 02 - Mulhalkele Watta – Extent: 0.4124 Hectare North: Lot No. 01 ; East: Lot No. 33 of P.P. Nu 678; South: Mulhalkelewatta claimed by Land Reforms Commission; West: Mulhalkelewatta claimed by Land Reforms Commission and Road.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso to section 38(a) of Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Column 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the Column 2 of that Schedule.
